$comment: How sync-upstream.mjs turns a CRUX-Compress release into this plugin. Every change made to upstream files is listed here.

extraFiles.$comment: Fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com at the release commit because the release zip leaves them out.

files.LICENSE.md: Upstream licence, shipped as the plugin's LICENSE

derived.$comment: Generated from upstream files at the release commit, then rewritten like synced files.

rewrites.$comment: Exact-string replacements applied to every synced text file, longest first. <plugin> is this plugin's install directory (see rules/crux-plugin-paths.mdc).

frontmatter.$comment: Keys added to files whose upstream frontmatter lacks what plugin loaders and validate-template require. Existing keys are never overwritten.

commands/crux-compress.md.name: crux-compress
commands/crux-compress.md.description: Compress markdown rules, code files, images, and web pages into CRUX notation for token efficiency.

commands/crux-dream.md.name: crux-dream
commands/crux-dream.md.description: Post-execution memory extraction and REM sleep rebalancing.

commands/crux-recall.md.name: crux-recall
commands/crux-recall.md.description: Decompress, query, and display CRUX memories in human-readable form.

commands/crux-remember.md.name: crux-remember
commands/crux-remember.md.description: Store ad-hoc memories outside of spec workflows; they join standard consolidation during REM sleep.

commands/crux-forget.md.name: crux-forget
commands/crux-forget.md.description: Remove memories from the CRUX memory corpus.

commands/crux-amnesia.md.name: crux-amnesia
commands/crux-amnesia.md.description: Temporarily disable or restore ambient CRUX memory usage for the current chat session.

commands/crux-meditate.md.name: crux-meditate
commands/crux-meditate.md.description: Run a recursive, memory-informed meditation on a topic: research, adversarial review, and a final report.

rules/crux-memories-integration.crux.mdc.description: CRUX memories: when to load the memory index and how to annotate memory references in responses.
